SELECT h.sales_order_id AS salesOrderId, d.sales_order_detail_id AS salesOrderDetailId, h.order_no AS orderNo, h.order_dt AS orderDt, c.customer_code AS customerCode, c.customer_name AS customerName, h.quot_no AS quotNo, h.status AS status, h.delivery_dt AS headerDeliveryDt, h.delivery_place AS deliveryPlace, h.delivery_method AS deliveryMethod, h.remark AS remark, d.line_no AS lineNo, m.material_code AS materialCode, m.material_name AS materialName, m.unit AS unit, d.order_qty AS orderQty, d.unit_price AS unitPrice, d.supply_amt AS supplyAmt, d.vat_amt AS vatAmt, d.total_amt AS totalAmt, COALESCE(d.delivery_dt, h.delivery_dt) AS deliveryDt, d.shipped_qty AS shippedQty, d.line_status AS lineStatus FROM tb_sales_order_hd h JOIN tb_sales_order_dt d ON d.sales_order_id = h.sales_order_id AND d.tenant_id = h.tenant_id LEFT JOIN tb_customer_info c ON c.customer_id = h.customer_id AND c.tenant_id = h.tenant_id LEFT JOIN tb_material_info m ON m.material_id = d.material_id AND m.tenant_id = d.tenant_id WHERE h.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND h.use_at = 'Y'
AND (h.order_no ILIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR c.customer_code ILIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR c.customer_name ILIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR m.material_code ILIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR m.material_name ILIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR h.quot_no ILIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%')
AND h.order_no ILIKE '%' || #{orderNo} || '%'
AND h.order_dt >= CAST(#{orderDtFrom} AS date)
AND h.order_dt <= CAST(#{orderDtTo} AS date)
AND (c.customer_code ILIKE '%' || #{customerKeyword} || '%' OR c.customer_name ILIKE '%' || #{customerKeyword} || '%')
AND h.quot_no ILIKE '%' || #{quotNo} || '%'
AND h.status = #{status}
AND COALESCE(d.delivery_dt, h.delivery_dt) >= CAST(#{deliveryDtFrom} AS date)
AND COALESCE(d.delivery_dt, h.delivery_dt) <= CAST(#{deliveryDtTo} AS date)
AND (m.material_code ILIKE '%' || #{materialKeyword} || '%' OR m.material_name ILIKE '%' || #{materialKeyword} || '%')
AND d.line_status = #{lineStatus}
ORDER BY h.order_dt DESC, h.order_no DESC, d.line_no
